responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the root module file and its nested module files. compiler/rustc_lint/src/unused.rs: Implements a broad set of lints for unused or no-effect code patterns, including ignored `#[must_use]` results, unused results in statements, unused delimiters and import braces, useless path statements and operations, unnecessary allocations, and related cleanup-oriented diagnostics. It provides both early and late passes for detecting dead, redundant, or misleading constructs that compile but have no intended effect.
